concepts.label: Bucket-level (Data Service) bloom filter
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the ep_bfilter_* family (ep_bfilter_enabled, ep_bfilter_fp_prob, ep_bfilter_key_count, ep_bfilter_residency_threshold) names a bloom filter mechanism at the Data-Service bucket/KVStore level, used to skip unnecessary disk reads for keys that don't exist. Minted as one mechanism rather than four field-level concepts. Kept deliberately separate from the already-promoted index:bloom-filter (Index Service / Plasma) - this page never states the two are related or distinct, so no relation was minted between them; flagged only as a cross_component_finding to avoid fabricating an unstated claim.

relations.subject: storage-engine:magma
relations.evidence: Note that the `ep_magma` statistics are returned on Couchbase Server Enterprise Edition only.

relations.subject: server/8.0/cli/cbstats/cbstats-config
relations.evidence: For a complete list of `common options`, see the table provided on the introductory page for [cbstats](../cbstats-intro.md#common-options).

notable_absence.finding: ep_conflict_resolution_type: seqno is returned with no enumeration of the other value(s) this setting can take, and no link to conflict-resolution documentation - notable because tool:cbstats's own promoted registry description already credits cbstats with exposing 'the clock-drift counters that timestamp-based conflict resolution depends on,' yet this specific config page, which reports the conflict-resolution TYPE itself, makes no connection to that mechanism at all.

cross_component_finding: ep_bfilter_enabled/ep_bfilter_fp_prob/ep_bfilter_key_count/ep_bfilter_residency_threshold name a bucket-level (Data Service / KVStore) bloom filter that is mechanically distinct from the already-promoted index:bloom-filter (Index Service, Plasma memory-management enhancement) - same generic term 'bloom filter', two different components in two different services. This page gives no indication a reader might confuse the two, which is itself worth flagging: nothing on this page (or, so far, on the Index Service bloom-filter pages) disambiguates the shared name across components.
cross_product_finding: Not applicable - the EE/CE split here (ep_magma stats requiring Enterprise Edition) is Server's own edition licensing, not a Capella-vs-Server distinction; no Capella content is present on this page.
